name: close-v1
description: Conformance vectors for verifyCloseTransaction. Set the clock to nowSeconds, call the verifier with input, and expect it to return (accept) or to throw a VerificationError with exactly error.code and error.message (reject). The code is the stable reason to branch on; the message is the current English wording. Each reject is one named mutation of the accept named in base: its transaction, its served registry snapshot, or both. Pass input.servedRegistry to the verifier when it is present. Every key is public.

vectors.name: minimal-direct-merge
vectors.description: A plain account with no subentries, merged straight to the address the user typed.

vectors.name: simple-account-with-subentries
vectors.description: Removes a data entry, cancels an offer and removes an empty trustline, then merges to the user's wallet.

vectors.name: claimable-balance-claim
vectors.description: Adds the trustline the user chose to claim a balance into, then claims it. A claim round delivers nothing, so it carries no memo.

vectors.name: multisig-close
vectors.description: A 2-of-2 account: removes the co-signer, lowers the thresholds to 0/1/1, then merges.

vectors.name: multisig-normalization-first
vectors.description: The first transaction of a 2-of-2 close: removes the co-signer and lowers the thresholds to 0/1/1, with no merge.

vectors.name: direct-merge-with-id-memo
vectors.description: Merges to a wallet the user typed with the id memo they confirmed.

vectors.name: exchange-close-through-intermediary
vectors.description: A close to a listed exchange: the merge pays an intermediary that forwards the whole balance to the exchange address the user typed, with their text memo.

vectors.name: testnet-stand-in-close-through-intermediary
vectors.description: A testnet close to the bundled registry's testnet-only exchange stand-in: the merge pays an intermediary that forwards the whole balance to it, with the user's id memo.

vectors.name: testnet-stand-in-is-a-wallet-on-mainnet
vectors.description: On mainnet the testnet-only stand-in is not listed, so a close to it is a plain merge straight to the address the user typed, with their memo.

vectors.name: transfer-to-chosen-account
vectors.description: Sends the USDC balance to the account the user chose for it, removes the trustline, then merges.

vectors.name: exchange-close-under-relaxing-snapshot
vectors.description: The exchange close through the intermediary, with a served snapshot that lists the exchange as needing neither the intermediary nor a memo. A bundled exchange's rules cannot be relaxed, so the close stands as it is.

vectors.name: exchange-close-under-emptied-snapshot
vectors.description: The exchange close through the intermediary, with a served snapshot that lists no exchange at all. A bundled exchange cannot be removed.

vectors.name: close-to-exchange-listed-by-snapshot
vectors.description: A direct merge to an exchange only the served snapshot lists, which accepts a merge but needs an id memo. The user confirmed an id memo, the snapshot's type.

vectors.name: exchange-close-with-numeric-text-memo
vectors.description: The exchange close through the intermediary, with a text memo of digits, the type the bundled registry gives the exchange.

vectors.name: exchange-close-under-snapshot-with-earlier-expiry
vectors.description: The exchange close through the intermediary, with a snapshot valid only until 2026-10-15, before the clock. A snapshot cannot move the bundled expiry earlier, so the bundled date stands.

vectors.name: exchange-close-past-bundled-expiry-extended-by-snapshot
vectors.description: The exchange close through the intermediary on 2027-02-01, past the bundled registry's validity, with a snapshot valid until 2027-03-01: within 120 days of the bundled date, so it extends it.

vectors.name: classic-conversion-to-xlm
vectors.description: Converts the USDC balance to XLM into the account with at least the 9.5 XLM the user was shown, then merges.

vectors.name: real-exit-phoenix-withdraw-liquidity
vectors.description: The real Phoenix withdraw_liquidity envelope the API's adapter built on testnet, verified at the moment it was built.

provenance.origin: Built, signed and submitted: ledger 5496350, successful.
provenance.limits: The pool is the project's own testnet redeploy of Phoenix's mainnet wasm, listed in the contract registry. The account state below is hand-written from the same plan step; its share token is the pool's CONFIG.share_token, read live on 2026-11-06.

vectors.name: real-exit-fxdao-pay-debt
vectors.description: The real FxDAO pay_debt envelope the API's adapter built on testnet, verified at the moment it was built.

provenance.origin: Built and simulated only, never submitted, from a friendbot-funded account.
provenance.limits: The vault is the project's own testnet redeploy of FxDAO's open-source contract. The adapter's health gate was stubbed for the capture. The account state below is hand-written; its vault figures match the ledger entry, and its debt token is the vault's Currency(usd).contract, read live on 2026-11-06.
